# T-NNN — <title>

Reachable, so nothing is wrong with where it sits. Three ways a template rots, in one file:

- `children:` is derived, so every task copied out of this starts with a stored derived field;
- `type: nonsense` is a single value the vocabulary does not have — the audit template's original
  defect, which named a `type` the config lacked;
- `business_value` offers a menu that has fallen behind the vocabulary by one value, which is the
  form that stays invisible longest, because every value it *does* offer is legal.

`title` and the body keep their angle-bracket slots, which are placeholders rather than defects and
must not be reported.
